recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up in core is needed for FHIR-24938 unless future Patient Care work changes Procedure.recorded semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-24938 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for Patient Care. It asked core Procedure.recorded to clarify that the recorded date can apply regardless of Procedure.status because FHIR-20602's original recorded definition did not make the not-done status case clear.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#131648e. Commit 131648e28d155e3d12ecb57fcb774c5899f81fab updated source/procedure/procedure-spreadsheet.xml to change Procedure.recorded's definition to include 'regardless of Procedure.status' and added J#24938 to the committee notes. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later converted Procedure from spreadsheet source to StructureDefinition XML while preserving the wording and the GF#20602, J#24938 note.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. The current combined branch's source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml defines Procedure.recorded with the requested status-independent wording, and procedure-event-mapping-exceptions records the expected divergence from generic Event.recorded. FHIR-20602 is supporting background; its broader scope included adding Procedure.recorded and a datatype/default-type question, so it was not separately decided here. Community searches found the referenced Patient Care minutes page and no Zulip or Confluence conflict.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The empty audit commit records that current FHIR core source already reflects the Published resolution for FHIR-24938.
